subject: general
question: Under which five-year plan was Bharat Nirman started by the Government of India to upgrade rural infrastructure?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tenth Five Year Plan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Bharat Nirman was launched during the **Tenth Five Year Plan** period (2002-2007).
 
• The initiative aimed at improving rural infrastructure, including areas such as irrigation, roads, housing, water supply, electrification, and telecommunication connectivity.
 
• The program sought to provide basic amenities and bridge the gap between rural and urban areas.
 
• It was a time-bound business plan for action in rural infrastructure for a period of four years (2005-2009).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The Tenth Five Year Plan aimed at achieving a GDP growth rate of 8% per annum.
 
• It emphasized the importance of social development and poverty reduction.
 
• The plan also focused on increasing employment opportunities and improving the quality of education and healthcare services.
 
• Other major initiatives during the Tenth Plan included the National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (NREGA), now known as MGNREGA, aimed at providing employment to rural households.
